description: What is said in a video in a video surface, as timestamped segments. Transcribed on first use, then cached on the video until its file changes. Pass `start`/`end` for a span. Viewer role required.

end.description: Optional end of the span. As a person writes it ("1:34", "1:34.5", "01:02:03") or as seconds (94).

refresh.description: Transcribe again instead of using the cached transcript.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts bare or org-prefixed form.

start.description: Optional start of the span. As a person writes it ("1:34", "1:34.5", "01:02:03") or as seconds (94).

surface_slug.description: Optional video surface slug. Omit for the first video surface.

video_id.description: The video's id, from list_videos. Optional when the surface holds a single video.

name: get_video_transcript
